logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Supporting illustration for the WO-01 pump-module decision brief. One editable SVG with two panels: (1) a six-stage selection workflow drawn as rounded blue boxes joined by arrows - specify the shared duty and test basis, judge quality ≥ 80, rank qualifying candidates by energy, quantify raw defects ≤ 5, lock the lowest-energy pick, zero remaining open questions; (2) a bar chart of measured energy per common acceptance run for P2 (12 kWh), P3 (52), P1 (56) and P4 (58) on a 0-80 kWh grid with gridlines every 20 kWh. The client-policy winner P2 is tagged "policy winner" in green; P4 is tagged "0 defects - watchlist" in amber, marking the report's principal open question. A footnote states the energy gaps versus the P2 baseline (+40, +44, +46 kWh) and that cost, delivery, maintenance and reliability data are unverified and excluded. Sans-serif, white background, no scripts or external resources.
